items.title: A Vision-Language Model for Coronary Angiography Interpretation and Clinical Decision Support
items.abstract_or_text: BACKGROUND: Coronary angiography remains the reference standard for diagnosing coronary artery disease and guiding revascularization, yet its interpretation requires expert integration of multi-view anatomy, lesion morphology and procedural context. Existing artificial intelligence approaches are largely task-specific, annotation-dependent and limited in capturing the semantic relationship between angiographic findings and interventional decision-making. Whether large-scale vision-language pretraining can enable transferable foundation-model representations for invasive coronary imaging remains unknown. METHODS We developed CAG-MIND, a domain-specific vision-language foundation model for coronary angiography, using 135,475 CAG examinations paired with procedural reports, comprising 812,850 angiographic videos from Zhongshan Hospital and Shanghai Geriatric Medical Center. Each case consisted of standardized six-view angiographic acquisitions paired with structured procedural semantics extracted from routine reports using a large language model-assisted pipeline. The model was pretrained by aligning multi-view angiographic representations with report-derived semantic embeddings through bidirectional contrastive learning. Performance was evaluated under zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning settings across 11 downstream tasks grouped into structural abnormality detection, atherosclerotic plaque assessment, and interventional decision prediction, using both an internal validation cohort and an independent external test cohort. RESULTS CAG-MIND demonstrated robust performance across all three task categories. In the zero-shot setting, the model achieved mean AUROCs of 0.686 in the internal validation cohort and 0.745 in the external test cohort, indicating transferable multimodal representations without task-specific supervision. Following supervised fine-tuning, the mean AUROC increased to 0.827 and 0.846, respectively, with excellent performance for coronary stenosis detection (AUROC 0.940 in both cohorts), balloon/stent prediction (0.900 and 0.907), and CABG recommendation (0.877 and 0.875). Compared with representative biomedical vision-language models and conventional image-based architectures, CAG-MIND consistently achieved superior performance in both zero-shot and supervised settings and remained superior to fully fine-tuned competing models when trained with only 10% of the labelled data. Grad-CAM visualization demonstrated anatomically plausible lesion-focused attention, supporting the interpretability of the learned representations. CONCLUSIONS CAG-MIND is, to our knowledge, the first large-scale vision-language foundation model for coronary angiography trained at more than 100,000-patient scale. By aligning standardized multi-view angiographic videos with report-derived procedural semantics, CAG-MIND enables robust zero-shot transfer, data-efficient fine-tuning and cross-center generalization. These findings support domain-aligned multimodal pretraining as a scalable foundation-model paradigm for invasive cardiovascular imaging and future cath-lab decision support.
items.summary_zh: CAG-MIND以13.5万例冠脉造影检查、81.3万段视频及手术报告训练视觉—语言基础模型，并在内部和独立外部队列的11项任务上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作展示了多视角侵入性心血管影像与临床语义对齐的规模化路径；外部测试结果支持其诊断和决策支持潜力，但临床部署价值仍待前瞻性验证。
items.author_line: Li, Z., Sun, Y., Jiang, C. 等 24 人
items.abstract_zh: 背景：冠状动脉造影仍是诊断冠状动脉疾病并指导血运重建的参考标准，但其判读需要专家整合多体位解剖、病变形态和操作情境。现有人工智能方法大多针对特定任务、依赖标注，且在捕捉造影所见与介入决策之间的语义关系方面有限。大规模视觉–语言预训练能否为有创冠状动脉影像提供可迁移的基础模型表征仍属未知。方法：我们开发了 CAG-MIND，一个面向冠状动脉造影的领域特异性视觉–语言基础模型，使用 135,475 例 CAG 检查及其配对的操作报告，包含来自中山医院和上海老年医学中心的 812,850 段造影视频。每例由标准化六体位造影采集与使用大语言模型辅助流程从常规报告中提取的结构化操作语义配对组成。模型通过双向对比学习将多体位造影表征与报告衍生的语义嵌入对齐进行预训练。在零样本和监督微调设置下评估性能，覆盖分为结构异常检测、动脉粥样硬化斑块评估和介入决策预测三大类的 11 项下游任务，使用内部验证队列和独立外部测试队列。结果：CAG-MIND 在全部三类任务上均表现出稳健性能。在零样本设置下，模型在内部验证队列中的平均 AUROC 为 0.686，在外部测试队列中为 0.745，表明在无任务特异性监督的情况下具有可迁移的多模态表征。监督微调后，平均 AUROC 分别升至 0.827 和 0.846，在冠状动脉狭窄检测（两个队列 AUROC 均为 0.940）、球囊/支架预测（0.900 和 0.907）以及 CABG 推荐（0.877 和 0.875）方面表现优异。与代表性生物医学视觉–语言模型及传统基于图像的架构相比，CAG-MIND 在零样本和监督设置下均持续取得更优性能，并且在仅使用 10% 标注数据训练时仍优于完全微调的竞争模型。Grad-CAM 可视化显示了解剖上合理的、以病变为中心的注意力，支持所学表征的可解释性。结论：据我们所知，CAG-MIND 是首个在超过 10 万例患者规模上训练的冠状动脉造影大规模视觉–语言基础模型。通过将标准化多体位造影视频与报告衍生的操作语义对齐，CAG-MIND 实现了稳健的零样本迁移、数据高效微调和跨中心泛化。这些发现支持将领域对齐的多模态预训练作为有创心血管影像及未来导管室决策支持的可扩展基础模型范式。

items.title: AI4Loop: an Artificial Intelligence Framework Reveals Increased 3D Chromatin Interactions and Therapeutic Vulnerabilities across 12,000 Cancer Samples
items.abstract_or_text: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions shape gene regulation, but their large-scale analysis remains limited by the cost and complexity of experimental assays. Here we present AI4Loop, a deep learning framework that infers genome-wide gene-centered chromatin interaction networks directly from RNA-seq data. Across multiple cell types, AI4Loop recovered interaction patterns consistent with clinical samples and orthogonal chromatin conformation datasets. Applied to 12,347 transcriptomes from 32 cancer types, AI4Loop revealed pervasive increases in gene-centered chromatin interactions in tumors, particularly at oncogene-associated loci. These inferred interaction networks outperformed gene expression alone in cancer classification. Integration with more than 50,000 drug-treated transcriptomes identified compounds predicted to reverse cancer-associated interaction gains. Hi-C experiments confirmed that the oxazolidinone antibiotics eperezolid and radezolid reduce breast cancer-gain chromatin interactions. Together, these results identify increased gene-centered chromatin interactions as a pan-cancer feature and provide a scalable strategy for linking 3D genome dysregulation to therapeutic vulnerabilities.
items.summary_zh: AI4Loop从RNA-seq推断基因中心染色质互作网络，分析32种癌症的12,347份转录组，并结合逾5万份药物处理转录组和Hi-C实验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把常规转录组与三维基因组假设连接起来，并以Hi-C观察支持部分预测；候选药物与治疗脆弱性的关系仍属待验证的研究线索。
items.author_line: Dao, F., Lebeau, B., Amuley, P. 等 11 人
items.abstract_zh: 三维染色质相互作用塑造基因调控，但其大规模分析仍受实验测定成本与复杂性的限制。本文介绍AI4Loop，这是一个直接从RNA-seq数据推断全基因组、以基因为中心的染色质相互作用网络的深度学习框架。在多种细胞类型中，AI4Loop恢复了与临床样本及正交染色质构象数据集一致的相互作用模式。应用于32种癌症类型的12,347个转录组时，AI4Loop揭示肿瘤中以基因为中心的染色质相互作用普遍增加，尤其是在癌基因相关位点。这些推断的相互作用网络在癌症分类上优于单独的基因表达。与超过50,000个药物处理转录组的整合鉴定出预测可逆转癌症相关相互作用增益的化合物。Hi-C实验证实，噁唑烷酮类抗生素eperezolid和radezolid可减少乳腺癌增益的染色质相互作用。综合来看，这些结果将以基因为中心的染色质相互作用增加鉴定为泛癌特征，并提供了一种将三维基因组失调与治疗脆弱性相联系的可扩展策略。

items.title: A machine learning framework for supervised treatment response prediction from tumor transcriptomics: A large-scale pan-cancer study
items.abstract_or_text: Precision oncology aims to guide treatment decisions using biomarkers. While DNA-based panels are increasingly applied, RNA transcriptomics remain underused due to limited datasets and the absence of robust models. We assembled the largest transcriptomic resource for drug response prediction to date, spanning 91 cohorts, 5,675 patients, nine cancer types, and six frontline therapies: anti-PD-1/PD-L1 immune-checkpoint inhibitors, trastuzumab, bevacizumab, BRAF inhibitors, paclitaxel, and FAC/FEC (Fluorouracil-Adriamycin-Cyclophosphamide/Fluorouracil-Epirubicin-Cyclophosphamide) chemotherapy. We developed EXPRESSO (EXpression-Profile-RESponSe-Optimizer), a supervised machine-learning framework that predicts treatment response from pre-treatment transcriptomes by integrating drug targets and context-specific biomarkers. EXPRESSO achieves mean ROC-AUCs of 0.62 - 0.73 and median odds ratios of 2.4 - 4.6 across therapies, outperforming 20 published transcriptomic signatures and other machine learning methods. Prospective validation on 22 independent cohorts confirms that performance generalizes beyond cross-validation. The EXPRESSO signature additionally stratifies progression-free survival in immune checkpoint blockade-treated cohorts, demonstrating prognostic value beyond binary response prediction. Robustness analysis reveals that predictive performance plateaued for some therapies with increasing training cohorts but continued to improve for others. These findings suggest inherent limits of supervised brute-force learning for certain treatments, but additional data and deeper mechanistic modeling may further enhance transcriptomics-based predictors.
items.summary_zh: EXPRESSO整合91个队列、5,675名患者、九类癌症和六种一线治疗的治疗前转录组，预测疗效并在22个独立队列中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨治疗和跨癌种的独立队列验证，为转录组疗效预测提供了较大规模比较；AUC范围有限，结果更适合视为辅助分层证据。
items.author_line: Pal, L. R., Gertz, E. M., Ulhas Nair, N. 等 16 人
items.abstract_zh: 精准肿瘤学旨在利用生物标志物指导治疗决策。基于 DNA 的 panel 应用日益增多，但 RNA 转录组学因数据集有限且缺乏稳健模型而仍未充分利用。我们组装了迄今最大的药物响应预测转录组资源，涵盖 91 个队列、5,675 名患者、九种癌症类型以及六种一线疗法：抗 PD-1/PD-L1 免疫检查点抑制剂、trastuzumab、bevacizumab、BRAF 抑制剂、paclitaxel，以及 FAC/FEC（Fluorouracil-Adriamycin-Cyclophosphamide/Fluorouracil-Epirubicin-Cyclophosphamide）化疗。我们开发了 EXPRESSO（EXpression-Profile-RESponSe-Optimizer），一种监督机器学习框架，通过整合药物靶点与情境特异性生物标志物，从治疗前转录组预测治疗响应。EXPRESSO 跨疗法达到平均 ROC-AUC 0.62–0.73 以及中位优势比 2.4–4.6，优于 20 个已发表转录组签名及其他机器学习方法。在 22 个独立队列上的前瞻性验证确认性能可泛化到交叉验证之外。EXPRESSO 签名还可对免疫检查点阻断治疗队列中的无进展生存进行分层，显示出超越二分类响应预测的预后价值。稳健性分析表明，部分疗法的预测性能随训练队列增加而趋于平台，而另一些则持续改善。这些发现提示监督式蛮力学习对某些治疗存在固有上限，但更多数据与更深入的机制建模或可进一步增强基于转录组的预测器。

items.title: DNA gyrase in live bacteria forms liquid condensates through weak multivalent bonding of excess GyrB
items.abstract_or_text: Type IIA bacterial topoisomerase DNA gyrase, a GyrA/GyrB heterotetramer, has crucial roles maintaining transcription and DNA replication by relaxing positive DNA supercoils through introducing negative supercoils. However, rates of gyrase-catalysed supercoiling in vitro cannot explain much higher rates required in vivo. To address this puzzle, we used high-speed single-molecule fluorescence imaging of GyrA/GyrB reporters in live Escherichia coli, indicating that cells contain ~40% more GyrB than GyrA expressed in a diffuse pool or in clusters whose mobility depends on whether they are bound to DNA. Unexpectedly, we discovered that clusters are non-stoichiometric containing ~150% more GyrB than GyrA, significantly greater than the cellular average, with fluorescence recovery after photobleaching revealing that clustered GyrA and GyrB behave as a liquid whose abundance can be increased by applying gyrase-targeting antibiotics. Structural docking indicates that the liquid state is stabilised through excess GyrB progressively binding to existing clusters via weak, multivalent interactions. By operating in liquid condensates, A2B2 that dissociates from DNA can rebind rapidly instead of diffusing away, increasing enzyme processivity to enable multiple rounds of catalysis that can keep pace with transcription and DNA replication in vivo. This demonstrates a new role for condensates of overcoming kinetic limitations imposed by diffusion.
items.summary_zh: 活细胞单分子荧光成像显示，大肠杆菌DNA旋转酶簇中GyrB相对富集，并呈现液体样动态；结构对接提出弱多价相互作用机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把细菌拓扑异构酶的空间组织与体内高通量超螺旋调控联系起来，提供了可检验的生物物理机制模型。
items.author_line: Syeda, A., Hollnds, K., Frame, L. 等 11 人
items.abstract_zh: IIA型细菌拓扑异构酶DNA促旋酶是一种GyrA/GyrB异源四聚体，通过引入负超螺旋来松弛正DNA超螺旋，从而在维持转录和DNA复制中发挥关键作用。然而，体外促旋酶催化超螺旋化的速率无法解释体内所需的高得多的速率。为解决这一谜题，我们在活大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中对GyrA/GyrB报告分子进行了高速单分子荧光成像，表明细胞中GyrB比GyrA多约40%，表达于弥散池或簇中，其流动性取决于它们是否结合DNA。出乎意料的是，我们发现这些簇是非化学计量的，所含GyrB比GyrA多约150%，显著高于细胞平均值；光漂白后荧光恢复显示，成簇的GyrA和GyrB表现为液体，其丰度可通过施加靶向促旋酶的抗生素而增加。结构对接表明，该液态通过过量GyrB经由弱的多价相互作用逐步结合到既有簇上而得到稳定。通过在液相凝聚体中运作，从DNA解离的A2B2可以迅速重新结合而非扩散离去，从而提高酶的持续合成能力，使多轮催化能够跟上体内转录和DNA复制的步伐。这展示了凝聚体克服扩散所施加的动力学限制的新作用。

items.title: Activity-based chemical proteomics uncovers unexpected covalent targetsof E64d and reveals a role for cysteine cathepsins in PLD3 proteostasis.
items.abstract_or_text: Catalytic activity of 5'-3' exonuclease Phospholipase D3 (PLD3) is associated with immune signaling and neurodegeneration including Alzheimer's disease. PLD3 undergoes multiple post-translational modifications and proteolytic cleavage to establish its catalytically active form. However, the proteases catalyzing the cleavage of PLD3 have remained unidentified. To study the proteolytic cleavage of PLD3, we have evaluated the small molecule covalent inhibitor E64d that blocks proteolysis catalyzed by cysteine cathepsins. To validate the selectivity of E64d, we have designed and synthetized an E64d propargyl analogue and carried out a detailed activity-based protein profiling to reveal a broad engagement of the compound with other protein targets including bleomycin hydrolase (BLMH), Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1), transcription elongation factor SPT5 (SUPT5H) and asparagine synthetase (ASNS). The specificity of the E64d-protein interactions was confirmed by biochemical assays and mass spectrometry-based site identifications. In neurons, treatment with E64d lead to about 50-fold PLD3 accumulation and dysregulation of its proteolytic cleavage, while there was only a minor overall change on the whole proteome level. Taken together, this study provides insights into previously unknown E64d selectivity and renders cysteine cathepsins responsible for PLD3 degradation in neurons. It highlights the importance of cysteine cathepsins activity in neuronal lysosomes for proper PLD3 processing and hence it suggests that their activation might be responsible for decreased PLD3 levels in neurons of patients with Alzheimer's diseases. These findings are key for further elucidation of PLD3 function in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary_zh: 活性探针化学蛋白质组学发现E64d具有超出半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶的共价靶标谱，并在神经元中观察到PLD3显著积累和加工失调。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作同时修正了常用抑制剂的选择性认识，并为PLD3蛋白稳态提出了蛋白酶相关机制；与阿尔茨海默病的联系尚需患者和功能研究支持。
items.abstract_zh: 5'-3' 外切核酸酶磷脂酶 D3（PLD3）的催化活性与免疫信号转导以及包括阿尔茨海默病在内的神经退行性疾病相关。PLD3 经历多种翻译后修饰和蛋白水解切割，以形成其催化活性形式。然而，催化 PLD3 切割的蛋白酶仍未被鉴定。为研究 PLD3 的蛋白水解切割，我们评估了可阻断半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶所催化蛋白水解的小分子共价抑制剂 E64d。为验证 E64d 的选择性，我们设计并合成了 E64d 炔丙基类似物，并开展了详细的基于活性的蛋白质谱分析，揭示该化合物还广泛作用于其他蛋白靶标，包括博来霉素水解酶（BLMH）、Kelch 样 ECH 相关蛋白 1（KEAP1）、转录延伸因子 SPT5（SUPT5H）以及天冬酰胺合成酶（ASNS）。E64d–蛋白相互作用的特异性通过生化实验和基于质谱的位点鉴定得到确认。在神经元中，E64d 处理导致 PLD3 约 50 倍蓄积及其蛋白水解切割失调，而全蛋白质组水平仅有轻微整体变化。综上，本研究揭示了此前未知的 E64d 选择性，并表明半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶负责神经元中 PLD3 的降解。研究强调了神经元溶酶体中半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶活性对 PLD3 正确加工的重要性，因而提示其激活可能是阿尔茨海默病患者神经元中 PLD3 水平降低的原因。这些发现对进一步阐明 PLD3 在神经退行性疾病中的功能至关重要。

items.title: A Two-Stage ESM-Based Machine Learning Pipeline for Robust Hierarchical Enzyme Function Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate enzyme annotation remains a major bottleneck in translating rapidly growing protein sequence data into biological knowledge. Enzyme Commission (EC) prediction is particularly challenging because enzyme functions are organized hierarchically, annotations are often imbalanced across classes, and sequence similarity alone may be insufficient to resolve functional differences. To address these challenges, we developed ESM-ECForest, a two-stage framework that combines protein embeddings generated by the pretrained language model ESM-2 (Evolutionary Scale Modeling 2) with Random Forest classifiers. The first stage distinguishes enzymes from non-enzymes, whereas the second assigns one or more EC numbers to proteins predicted to be enzymatic. On an external benchmark comprising 25,778 protein sequences, ESM-ECForest achieved the highest weighted F1 score among the evaluated methods at all four EC levels, decreasing from 0.94 at Level 1 to 0.90 at Level 4. The largest relative improvements were observed for lyases (EC 4), ligases (EC 6), and translocases (EC 7), although EC 6 and EC 7 remained the most difficult classes internally. Visualization of the ESM-2 embedding space using Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) revealed clustering patterns consistent with enzyme functional relationships, indicating that biologically relevant information is retained in the pretrained representations prior to supervised classification. These results support the use of pretrained protein language model embeddings as an effective foundation for enzyme annotation. By combining large-scale sequence representations with a lightweight supervised classifier, ESM-ECForest provides a scalable approach for EC prediction and may facilitate functional annotation of protein sequences derived from large genomic and metagenomic datasets.
items.summary_zh: ESM-ECForest将ESM-2蛋白表征与两阶段随机森林结合，在25,778条蛋白质的外部基准上进行层级EC酶学功能预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 轻量监督模型与蛋白语言模型表征的组合，为大规模基因组和宏基因组注释提供了实用方案；仍需在真实新颖蛋白发现任务中检验。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的酶注释仍是将快速增长的蛋白质序列数据转化为生物学知识的主要瓶颈。酶委员会（EC）编号预测尤其困难，因为酶功能呈层级组织、各类别注释往往不平衡，且仅靠序列相似性可能不足以分辨功能差异。为应对这些挑战，我们开发了 ESM-ECForest，这是一个两阶段框架，将预训练语言模型 ESM-2（Evolutionary Scale Modeling 2）生成的蛋白质嵌入与随机森林分类器相结合。第一阶段区分酶与非酶，第二阶段为预测为酶的蛋白质分配一个或多个 EC 编号。在包含 25,778 条蛋白质序列的外部基准上，ESM-ECForest 在全部四个 EC 层级上均获得所评估方法中最高的加权 F1 分数，由第 1 级的 0.94 降至第 4 级的 0.90。相对改进最大的是裂合酶（EC 4）、连接酶（EC 6）和移位酶（EC 7），尽管 EC 6 和 EC 7 在内部仍是最困难的类别。使用均匀流形逼近与投影（UMAP）对 ESM-2 嵌入空间的可视化显示出与酶功能关系一致的聚类模式，表明在监督分类之前，预训练表征中已保留了生物学相关信息。这些结果支持将预训练蛋白质语言模型嵌入作为酶注释的有效基础。通过将大规模序列表征与轻量级监督分类器相结合，ESM-ECForest 为 EC 预测提供了可扩展方法，并可能促进来自大型基因组和宏基因组数据集的蛋白质序列功能注释。

items.title: Protein language models and the long tail of functional diversity
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language model performance on downstream tasks depends on the pretraining data, motivating recent efforts to combine genomic- and metagenomic-derived protein sequences into large-scale atlases. Because these datasets are highly redundant, sequences are typically clustered by similarity and sampled during training. Sequences that do not belong to any cluster, known as ``singletons'', are typically excluded from training and evaluation because they are considered to be artifacts. However, singletons represent the long tail of functional diversity and are abundant in many large-scale atlases: nearly 43\% of the 3.34 billion sequences in the joint genomic-metagenomic dataset GigaRef are singletons. Here, we characterize singletons derived from UniRef and GigaRef by assessing whether clustering missed homologs, how much their exclusion affects protein language model (PLM) training, and which biological domains they contain. We find that many GigaRef singletons belong to a cluster under alternative parameter settings, suggesting that genomic and metagenomic datasets may require dataset-specific clustering configurations. We also show that singletons share mutual information with clustered sequences, making them learnable by PLMs and useful for training. Finally, metagenomic singletons carry denser, more diverse domain content than clustered sequences, including domain-level homology that sequence-identity clustering misses. Together, these results support including singletons in PLM training and call for closer examination of data curation in large-scale integrated sequence atlases.
items.summary_zh: 研究审查GigaRef中约33.4亿序列的聚类策略，指出约43%的单例序列携带被常规相似性聚类遗漏的多样化结构域信息。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接影响蛋白语言模型训练数据的取舍，并提示宏基因组长尾功能多样性可能被系统性低估。
items.author_line: Vinod, R., Char, S., Amini, A. P. 等 5 人
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型在下游任务上的性能依赖于预训练数据，这促使近期将基因组来源与宏基因组来源的蛋白质序列合并为大规模图谱的努力。由于这些数据集高度冗余，序列通常按相似性聚类并在训练中采样。不属于任何簇的序列被称为“单例”（singleton），通常被排除在训练和评估之外，因为它们被视为伪迹。然而，单例代表功能多样性的长尾，并在许多大规模图谱中很丰富：联合基因组–宏基因组数据集GigaRef中的33.4亿条序列里，近43%是单例。在此，我们通过评估聚类是否遗漏了同源物、排除单例对蛋白质语言模型（PLM）训练的影响有多大，以及它们包含哪些生物学结构域，来表征来自UniRef和GigaRef的单例。我们发现，许多GigaRef单例在替代参数设置下属于某个簇，提示基因组与宏基因组数据集可能需要数据集特异性的聚类配置。我们还表明，单例与成簇序列共享互信息，因此可被PLM学习并对训练有用。最后，宏基因组单例比成簇序列携带更密集、更多样的结构域内容，包括序列一致性聚类所遗漏的结构域水平同源性。综合来看，这些结果支持将单例纳入PLM训练，并呼吁对大规模整合序列图谱中的数据整理进行更仔细的审视。

items.title: Physically Grounded Generative Modeling of All-Atom Biomolecular Dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting the kinetic pathways of biomolecular systems at all-atom resolution is crucial for understanding protein function and drug efficacy, yet this task is hindered by the immense computational cost of conventional molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. While deep learning has revolutionized static structure prediction and equilibrium ensemble sampling, simulating the kinetics of conformational transitions remains a critical challenge. We introduce BioKinema, a physically grounded generative model that predicts continuous-time, all-atom biomolecular trajectories at a fraction of the cost of traditional simulations. In particular, BioKinema utilizes a spatial-temporal diffusion architecture motivated by the exponential decay of correlations characteristic of Langevin dynamics, and is explicitly trained to generate trajectories with the correct kinetics and thermodynamics. It employs a hierarchical forecasting-and-interpolation strategy to overcome the error accumulation that often plagues long-horizon generation. Through extensive validation, we demonstrate that BioKinema generates physically stable and dynamically accurate trajectories suitable for rigorous downstream analysis. For protein systems, it reproduces the equilibrium thermodynamics of the conformational ensemble and the underlying kinetics. For protein-ligand complexes, it successfully elucidates mechanisms such as ligand-driven conformational changes and allosteric interactions. Furthermore, BioKinema leverages enhanced sampling data to predict rare kinetic events, emerging as a powerful tool for estimating ligand unbinding pathways. Collectively, these results establish BioKinema as a computationally efficient complement to MD simulations that bridges the gap between static structure and dynamic function, enabling high-throughput exploration of the kinetic landscape for structural biology and drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: BioKinema以时空扩散架构生成全原子生物分子连续时间轨迹，报告可再现蛋白构象动力学、热力学及蛋白—配体稀有事件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若其物理一致性可在更多体系中复现，可能加快结构生物学和药物发现中的动力学采样；当前证据主要来自计算验证。
items.author_line: Feng, B., Zhang, J., Zhang, X. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: 以全原子分辨率预测生物分子体系的动力学路径对于理解蛋白质功能与药效至关重要，但该任务受制于传统分子动力学（MD）模拟的巨大计算代价。尽管深度学习已变革静态结构预测与平衡系综采样，模拟构象转变的动力学仍是一项关键挑战。我们提出 BioKinema，一种物理奠基的生成模型，能以传统模拟的一小部分代价预测连续时间、全原子生物分子轨迹。具体而言，BioKinema 采用受 Langevin 动力学特征性相关指数衰减启发的时空扩散架构，并经显式训练以生成具有正确动力学与热力学的轨迹。它采用分层预测–插值策略，以克服长时程生成中常见的误差累积。通过广泛验证，我们表明 BioKinema 生成物理稳定、动力学准确、适合严格下游分析的轨迹。对于蛋白质体系，它复现构象系综的平衡热力学及底层动力学。对于蛋白–配体复合物，它成功阐明配体驱动的构象变化与别构相互作用等机制。此外，BioKinema 利用增强采样数据预测稀有动力学事件，成为估计配体解离路径的有力工具。综合来看，这些结果确立 BioKinema 作为 MD 模拟的计算高效补充，弥合静态结构与动态功能之间的差距，使结构生物学与药物发现能够高通量探索动力学图景。

items.title: A Conversational Multi-Agent AI System for Integrated Multi-Omics Analysis and Biomedical Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell and spatial omics offer unprecedented opportunities to decipher the mechanisms of disease, however, this process requires teams of experts, iterative trial-and-error and reasoning across modalities. Here we present LungChat (https://chat.lungmap.net), a conversational system for integrated multi-omics analysis and biomedical discovery, deployed as a hierarchical multi-agent architecture in which a supervisor decomposes natural-language questions into parallel, tool-grounded tasks spanning single-cell and spatial analyses, literature and clinical-trial synthesis, and drug repurposing. To predict new therapeutics, LungChat implements Direction-Aware Repurposing and Targeting (DART) to distinguish perturbations that reverse disease transcriptional programs from those that reinforce them, at the cell-type level, for safety prediction. Controlled architecture ablations showed that hierarchical orchestration improved grounded abstention and token efficiency and preserved strong performance on complex multi-step tasks. In pulmonary disease case studies, LungChat independently prioritized saracatinib for IPF through drug-connectivity screening, followed by DART-based cell-type analysis; the same compound has been evaluated in the STOP-IPF clinical trial ( NCT04598919 ). The system also recovered fluticasone propionate, an established COPD therapy, through a single orchestrated analysis. This tissue-agnostic system provides a blueprint for verifiable agentic AI systems that support reproducible scientific discovery.
items.summary_zh: LungChat以分层多智能体架构编排单细胞、空间组学、文献和临床试验信息，并通过消融实验评价复杂任务表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该系统强调可追踪的多模态生物医学分析流程，并提出细胞类型层面的药物方向性分析；药物优先级结果仍是计算假设。
items.author_line: Rajdeo P, Asanuma S, Kouril M 等 9 人
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞与空间组学为解析疾病机制提供了前所未有的机遇，然而这一过程需要专家团队、反复试错以及跨模态推理。在此我们提出LungChat（https://chat.lungmap.net），一个用于整合多组学分析与生物医学发现的对话系统，以分层多智能体架构部署：由监督者将自然语言问题分解为并行的、基于工具的任务，涵盖单细胞与空间分析、文献与临床试验综合，以及药物再利用。为预测新疗法，LungChat实现了方向感知再利用与靶向（DART），以在细胞类型水平区分逆转疾病转录程序的扰动与强化这些程序的扰动，用于安全性预测。受控架构消融表明，分层编排改善了有依据的弃答与token效率，并在复杂多步任务上保持了强劲表现。在肺部疾病案例研究中，LungChat通过药物连通性筛选独立优先推荐saracatinib用于IPF，随后进行基于DART的细胞类型分析；同一化合物已在STOP-IPF临床试验（NCT04598919）中接受评估。该系统还通过一次编排分析回收了已确立的COPD治疗药物fluticasone propionate。这一组织无关系统为可验证的智能体AI系统提供了蓝图，以支持可重复的科学发现。

items.title: Accurate and Robust Characterization of Structural Variants at Low Coverages with ARCLID
items.abstract_or_text: Structural variants (SVs) shape genome diversity and underlie human diseases, yet accurate detection remains difficult, especially at low sequencing coverages. Most existing callers are optimized for deep sequencing and lose sensitivity as coverage falls, limiting their use in studies that sequence genomes at shallow depth. We present ARCLID, a deep learning-based SV caller that reframes SV detection as an object detection task. We benchmarked ARCLID against six well-established callers on four samples and challenging medically relevant genes, across coverages from 28x down to 5x, multiple SV sizes, and both relaxed and strict breakpoint matching. At 5x, ARCLID achieved the highest F1 score of all evaluated callers on every sample, exceeding the second-best tool by up to 8%. This advantage widened under strict breakpoint matching, indicating genuine variant recovery with accurate breakpoint placement. At higher coverages, ARCLID remains competitive with the strongest current tools. By preserving accuracy at low depth, it makes reliable SV discovery feasible from shallow data, enabling lower sequencing cost, time, and storage for population-scale and clinical genomics. We additionally curated SV benchmarking regions for HG00733 and NA19240 that complement the widely used HG002 GIAB benchmark regions, supporting evaluation of SV callers across ancestrally distinct genomes.
items.summary_zh: ARCLID将低覆盖度结构变异识别建模为目标检测，在四个样本、5×至28×覆盖度及多种断点匹配标准下比较六类既有工具。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 5×覆盖度下的基准优势和新增祖源多样化评测区域，有望降低群体与临床基因组学的测序成本；临床效用仍需真实流程验证。
items.author_line: Tavakoli, S., Frandsen, R. J. N., Majidian, S. 等 4 人
items.abstract_zh: 结构变异（SV）塑造基因组多样性并构成人类疾病的基础，但准确检测仍然困难，在低测序覆盖度下尤甚。现有大多数检测器针对深度测序优化，覆盖度下降时灵敏度丧失，限制了其在浅层测序研究中的使用。我们提出 ARCLID，一种将 SV 检测重新表述为目标检测任务的基于深度学习的 SV 检测器。我们在四个样本及具有挑战性的医学相关基因上，于 28× 降至 5× 的覆盖度、多种 SV 大小以及宽松与严格断点匹配条件下，将 ARCLID 与六个成熟检测器进行基准比较。在 5× 时，ARCLID 在每个样本上均获得所有评估检测器中最高的 F1 分数，最高超出次优工具 8%。该优势在严格断点匹配下进一步扩大，表明是带有准确断点定位的真实变异恢复。在更高覆盖度下，ARCLID 仍与当前最强工具具有竞争力。通过在低深度下保持准确性，它使从浅层数据中可靠发现 SV 成为可能，从而降低群体规模与临床基因组学的测序成本、时间与存储。我们还为 HG00733 与 NA19240 整理了 SV 基准区域，以补充广泛使用的 HG002 GIAB 基准区域，支持跨祖先差异基因组评估 SV 检测器。

items.title: ACCREDIT: A Quality-Aware Agentic Engine for Cell-resolved Cross-modal Image Registration with Dynamic Iterative Tuning
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial omics across complementary modalities is transforming our understanding of tissue architecture. Realizing this potential requires accurate and robust registration of cross-platform molecular images with hematoxylin-and-eosin (H&E) sections, the primary morphological reference for pathology. Existing methods, however, often fail silently when image orientation is unknown, image contrast is inverted, or tissue overlap is incomplete, producing erroneous registrations without alerting users or attempting recovery. Here, we present ACCREDIT, a quality-aware agentic framework that redefines cross-modal registration as an adaptive decision-making process rather than a one-shot computation. ACCREDIT combines deterministic registration pipelines with a reference-free composite quality score that automatically evaluates registration quality and rejects plausible but biologically incorrect registrations. When registration quality is insufficient, a large language model (LLM)-based rescue agent autonomously diagnoses failure modes and selects targeted recovery strategies, while an optional strategy-learning module captures expert-validated corrections for future reuse. Across Xenium, CODEX, cell-boundary, and IHC-to-H&E registration tasks, ACCREDIT outperformed competing methods by detecting registration failures and improving alignment quality through automated recovery and rescue. Ultimately, ACCREDIT enables robust integration of histology and spatial molecular profiling, providing a foundation for translating spatial omics into routine H&E-based pathology workflows.
items.summary_zh: ACCREDIT为Xenium、CODEX、细胞分割边界和IHC至H&E等跨模态图像配准提供质量评分、失败诊断和自动策略选择。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 空间组学整合常受静默错配影响，该框架将配准质量显式纳入计算流程，可能提升组织空间分析的可靠性。
items.author_line: Zhou, L., Zhao, F., Ren, T. 等 12 人
items.abstract_zh: 跨互补模态的空间组学正在改变我们对组织架构的理解。实现这一潜力需要将跨平台分子图像与苏木精–伊红（H&E）切片——病理学的主要形态学参照——进行准确且稳健的配准。然而，现有方法在图像方向未知、图像对比度反转或组织重叠不完整时常常静默失败，产生错误配准却既不提醒用户也不尝试恢复。本文介绍ACCREDIT，这是一个质量感知的智能体框架，将跨模态配准重新定义为自适应决策过程，而非一次性计算。ACCREDIT将确定性配准流程与无需参照的综合质量评分相结合，自动评估配准质量并拒绝看似合理但生物学上不正确的配准。当配准质量不足时，基于大语言模型（LLM）的救援智能体自主诊断失败模式并选择针对性恢复策略，同时可选的策略学习模块捕获经专家验证的校正以供未来复用。在Xenium、CODEX、细胞边界以及IHC到H&E的配准任务中，ACCREDIT通过检测配准失败并经由自动恢复与救援改善对齐质量，优于竞争方法。最终，ACCREDIT实现了组织学与空间分子图谱的稳健整合，为将空间组学转化为常规基于H&E的病理工作流提供了基础。

items.title: Self-supervised generation of realistic training data enables nanoscale localization in challenging conditions
items.abstract_or_text: Localization microscopy has overcome the diffraction limit, i.e. the conventional resolution limit of a microscope, enabling nanoscale biological imaging by precisely determining the positions of individual emitters such as single fluorescent molecules. However, the performance of deep learning methods, commonly applied to these tasks, depends significantly on the quality of training data, typically generated through simulation. Creating simulations that perfectly replicate experimental conditions remains challenging, resulting in a persistent simulation-to-experiment gap. To bridge this gap, we propose a physics-informed generative model leveraging self-supervised learning directly on experimental data. Our model extends the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework by incorporating a physical model of the Point Spread Function (PSF; the image of a single point source in the microscope) into the decoder, enabling it to disentangle learned realistic environments from emitters. Trained directly on unlabeled experimental images, our model intrinsically captures realistic background, noise patterns, and emitter characteristics. The decoder thus acts as a high-fidelity generator, producing fully labeled, realistic training images with known emitter locations. Using these generated datasets significantly improves the performance of supervised localization networks, particularly in challenging scenarios such as complex backgrounds and low signal-to-noise ratios. We demonstrate our approach on a variety of experimentally measured microscopy data, including super-resolution imaging in 2D and 3D and particle tracking in live cells, showing substantial improvements in localization precision and emitter detection.
items.summary_zh: 该方法以物理点扩散函数约束的自监督生成模型，从未标注实验显微图像生成带真值位置的训练数据，用于超分辨定位。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对模拟数据与真实显微条件之间的差异，在2D、3D和活细胞粒子追踪实验中改善定位表现。
items.author_line: Goldenberg, O., Daniel, T., Xiao, D. 等 6 人
items.abstract_zh: 定位显微术已突破衍射极限（即显微镜的传统分辨率极限），通过精确确定单个发射体（如单个荧光分子）的位置，实现纳米尺度生物成像。然而，常用于这些任务的深度学习方法的性能在很大程度上取决于训练数据质量，而训练数据通常通过模拟生成。创建能完美复现实验条件的模拟仍然困难，导致持续存在的模拟–实验差距。为弥合这一差距，我们提出一种物理信息生成模型，直接在实验数据上利用自监督学习。我们的模型扩展了深度潜粒子（Deep Latent Particles，DLP）框架，将点扩散函数（PSF；显微镜中单个点源的像）的物理模型纳入解码器，使其能够将所学真实环境与发射体解耦。模型直接在未标注实验图像上训练，因而内在地捕捉真实背景、噪声模式与发射体特征。解码器由此充当高保真生成器，生成带有已知发射体位置的全标注、逼真训练图像。使用这些生成数据集显著提升了监督定位网络的性能，尤其是在复杂背景与低信噪比等挑战性场景中。我们在多种实验测量的显微数据上展示该方法，包括二维与三维超分辨成像以及活细胞中的粒子追踪，显示出定位精度与发射体检测的显著改善。

items.title: A leakage-controlled benchmark shows apparent codon-language-model advantages in synonymous-variant prediction are evaluation artifacts
items.abstract_or_text: Synonymous codon choices shape mRNA stability, translation, and folding, and codon language models (cLMs) are increasingly reported to read this biology from sequence. However, when a true signal is thin relative to a confounding one, standard evaluation protocols can manufacture the reported gain rather than measure it, and we show this is what has happened for cLMs on synonymous-variant prediction. Under random splits, the codon advantage is large: tokenization gaps of +2.3~14.3 percentage points (pp) and pretrained codon leads of +8.0 pp over the strongest protein model (ESM-1b) and up to +10.0 pp over ESM-2. We find these numbers are properties of the measurement, not the models. A memorization baseline outscores every neural model; the advantage collapses under gene-held-out evaluation; the sole surviving residual dissolves into six defensible probe defaults; and the synonym-randomization drop that appeared to confirm true signal is itself variance under pooled analysis (0.3 pp, p = 0.49). No advantage survives leakage-controlled evaluation with pooled statistics. We release CodonBench, a leakage-controlled benchmark with an emergent audit cascade, and characterize how artifacts accumulate at every pipeline step. A thin signal (I({sigma};Y|A) {approx} 0.04 bits) may exist but is not reliably detectable at current sample sizes; we specify what detecting it would require.
items.summary_zh: CodonBench以基因留出和统计汇总检验重评同义变异预测，发现常见随机划分下的密码子语言模型优势可由评估泄漏解释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这项负结果为变异效应模型建立了更严格的评测规范，并公开基准与审计流程，具有直接的可复现性价值。
items.author_line: Liang, Y., Zhu, W., Liang, H. 等 4 人
items.abstract_zh: 同义密码子选择塑造mRNA稳定性、翻译与折叠，密码子语言模型（cLM）被越来越多地报道可从序列中读取这一生物学。然而，当真实信号相对于混杂信号较薄时，标准评估协议可能制造出所报告的增益而非测量它；我们表明，这正是cLM在同义变异预测上所发生的情况。在随机划分下，密码子优势很大：分词差距为+2.3~14.3个百分点（pp），预训练密码子模型相对最强蛋白质模型（ESM-1b）领先+8.0 pp，相对ESM-2最多领先+10.0 pp。我们发现这些数字是测量的属性，而非模型的属性。一个记忆化基线超过每一个神经模型；该优势在基因留出评估下崩溃；唯一残存的残余溶解为六个可辩护的探针默认设置；而看似确认真实信号的同义随机化下降，在合并分析下本身就是方差（0.3 pp，p = 0.49）。在带有合并统计的泄漏受控评估中，没有任何优势得以保留。我们发布CodonBench，这是一个带有涌现审计级联的泄漏受控基准，并刻画伪迹如何在流水线的每一步累积。可能存在微弱信号（I(σ;Y|A) ≈ 0.04 bits），但在当前样本量下无法可靠检测；我们明确了检测该信号所需的条件。

items.title: Automated Bone Marrow Cellularity Estimation from Whole-Slide Images Using Deep Learning: Validation in an Indian Clinical Cohort
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Bone marrow evaluation is central to diagnosing leukemia, lymphoma, unexplained cytopenias and other hematologic disorders, yet it depends on specialised expertise and remains time-consuming, subjective and prone to interobserver variability. We present the Artificial Intelligence Slide Analysis Platform (AiSAP), a deep learning framework for automated bone marrow cellularity estimation directly from raw whole-slide images (WSIs), trained and validated on an Indian clinical trephine biopsy cohort that is underrepresented in existing automated pipelines. Unlike approaches restricted to cropped or pre-selected patches, AiSAP performs end-to-end WSI tiling, automated marrow region-of-interest extraction and adipocyte segmentation using a dual Mask R-CNN architecture, before computing a case-level cellularity ratio. Across five backbone configurations, average precision ranged from 45.3% to 51.9%, while case-level concordance reached up to a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.95 and Lin's concordance correlation coefficient of 0.88 (depending on the backbone). These results show that AiSAP achieves expert-level concordance for automated cellularity estimation and represents a promising, generalizable step toward clinical decision support in bone marrow pathology, warranting further multi-institutional validation.
items.summary_zh: AiSAP对印度临床骨髓活检全切片进行端到端分块、骨髓区域识别和脂肪细胞分割，并计算病例级细胞密度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 全切片流程在代表性不足的人群队列中达到较高的病理学一致性，为骨髓病理辅助评估提供候选工具；仍需多机构验证。
items.author_line: Patil AP, Rastogi P, Sunderasan D 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 骨髓评估对诊断白血病、淋巴瘤、不明原因血细胞减少及其他血液系统疾病至关重要，但其依赖专科专业知识，且耗时、主观，并易受观察者间变异影响。我们提出人工智能切片分析平台（AiSAP），这是一个深度学习框架，可直接从原始全切片图像（WSI）自动估计骨髓细胞密度，并在一个现有自动化流程中代表性不足的印度临床环钻活检队列上训练和验证。与仅限于裁剪或预选图块的方法不同，AiSAP执行端到端WSI分块、自动骨髓感兴趣区域提取，并使用双Mask R-CNN架构进行脂肪细胞分割，随后计算病例水平的细胞密度比值。在五种骨干网络配置中，平均精度为45.3%至51.9%，而病例水平一致性最高可达Pearson相关系数0.95及Lin一致性相关系数0.88（取决于骨干网络）。这些结果表明，AiSAP在自动细胞密度估计方面达到了专家水平的一致性，是迈向骨髓病理临床决策支持的有前景、可推广的一步，有待进一步多机构验证。

items.title: Machine learning models for predicting prostate cancer and clinically significant prostate cancer at biopsy: An updated analysis of an expanded Japanese cohort
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundA 2019 report from our institution described a multilayer artificial neural network (ANN) for predicting prostate cancer at biopsy in 334 patients, trained with TensorFlow 1.x and evaluated at three fixed step counts without separating hyperparameter selection from test evaluation. We re-analyzed an expanded cohort from the same institution using contemporary machine-learning practice. MethodsWe pooled all available biopsy episodes from the same institutional database (n = 526; 524 after excluding one non-binary outcome code and one record with missing digital rectal examination [DRE] data), retaining the same seven predictors used in the original report (age, prior biopsy history, PSA, prostate volume, DRE, and MRI diffusion-weighted imaging findings in the peripheral and transition zones). Because 27 patients contributed more than one biopsy episode, we used patient-ID-grouped, stratified k-fold cross-validation (StratifiedGroupKFold; scikit-learn 1.8.0) with 3 and 5 folds, repeated over 10 random partitions, to avoid leakage between folds. Four classifiers were compared: L2-regularized logistic regression, gradient boosting, random forest, and a shallow (single hidden layer) multilayer perceptron. Two outcomes were modeled: detection of any prostate cancer, and detection of clinically significant prostate cancer (Gleason score [≥] 7). ResultsAny-cancer prevalence was 55.7% (292/524) and Gleason score [≥] 7 prevalence was 39.7% (208/524). With repeated 5-fold cross-validation, gradient boosting gave the highest discrimination for any prostate cancer (mean AUC 0.826, 95% CI 0.823-0.830) and for Gleason score [≥] 7 (mean AUC 0.855, 95% CI 0.852-0.859), closely followed by random forest and logistic regression (AUC 0.81-0.85). The shallow multilayer perceptron performed worse and less consistently than the other three models (any-cancer AUC 0.671; Gleason score [≥] 7 AUC 0.742) and than the deeper five-hidden-layer ANN reported in 2019. Results with 3-fold cross-validation were essentially unchanged. ConclusionsIn an expanded cohort, regularized logistic regression, gradient boosting, and random forest all discriminated prostate cancer at biopsy at least as well as the previously reported multilayer ANN, using far simpler models and a methodology that separates hyperparameter tuning from performance estimation. A shallow neural network offered no advantage over these simpler alternatives in this sample size. This is a preprint; the study has not undergone external peer review.
items.summary_zh: 研究以524次活检记录的日本单中心队列，采用患者分组、重复交叉验证比较逻辑回归、梯度提升、随机森林和浅层神经网络。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它用更严格的分组验证重审既有前列腺癌预测模型，显示简单模型表现相近或更好，强调临床机器学习中泄漏控制的重要性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：本机构 2019 年的报告描述了一个用于在 334 例患者中预测活检前列腺癌的多层人工神经网络（ANN），使用 TensorFlow 1.x 训练，并在三个固定步数下评估，未将超参数选择与测试评估分离。我们采用当代机器学习实践，对来自同一机构的扩大队列进行了再分析。方法：我们汇总了同一机构数据库中所有可用的活检事件（n = 526；在排除一个非二元结局编码和一条缺失直肠指检 [DRE] 数据的记录后为 524），保留原报告中使用的相同七个预测变量（年龄、既往活检史、PSA、前列腺体积、DRE，以及外周带和移行带的 MRI 扩散加权成像所见）。由于 27 例患者贡献了一次以上的活检事件，我们使用按患者 ID 分组、分层的 k 折交叉验证（StratifiedGroupKFold；scikit-learn 1.8.0），分别采用 3 折和 5 折，并在 10 次随机划分上重复，以避免折间泄漏。比较了四种分类器：L2 正则化逻辑回归、梯度提升、随机森林以及浅层（单隐层）多层感知机。建模了两种结局：任何前列腺癌的检出，以及临床显著前列腺癌（Gleason 评分 [≥] 7）的检出。结果：任何癌症患病率为 55.7%（292/524），Gleason 评分 [≥] 7 患病率为 39.7%（208/524）。在重复 5 折交叉验证中，梯度提升对任何前列腺癌的判别最高（平均 AUC 0.826，95% CI 0.823-0.830），对 Gleason 评分 [≥] 7 亦然（平均 AUC 0.855，95% CI 0.852-0.859），随机森林和逻辑回归紧随其后（AUC 0.81-0.85）。浅层多层感知机的表现弱于且不如其他三种模型稳定（任何癌症 AUC 0.671；Gleason 评分 [≥] 7 AUC 0.742），也弱于 2019 年报告的更深的五隐层 ANN。3 折交叉验证的结果基本不变。结论：在扩大队列中，正则化逻辑回归、梯度提升和随机森林对活检前列腺癌的判别均至少不逊于先前报告的多层 ANN，所用模型远更简单，且方法上将超参数调优与性能估计分离。在此样本量下，浅层神经网络相对于这些更简单的替代方案并无优势。本文为预印本；该研究尚未经过外部同行评审。

items.title: Effect of Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Secretome Injection on Functional Outcomes After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using Peroneus Longus Tendon Autograft: A Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Introduction : Graft healing after anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction remains challenging, as inadequate ligamentization and tendon–bone integration can lead to graft failure. Mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived secretome, a cell-free conditioned medium containing bioactive factors, has demonstrated promising regenerative potential in preclinical studies. This study compared six-month functional outcomes of ACL reconstruction using a peroneus longus tendon (PLT) autograft with and without adjuvant secretome injection. Methods : A double-blind randomized controlled trial enrolled 24 participants undergoing arthroscopic single-bundle ACL reconstruction with a PLT autograft, randomly assigned to receive intralesional secretome injection into the graft (secretome group, n = 12) or saline placebo (control group, n = 12). Functional outcomes were assessed preoperatively and at six months using the International Knee Documentation Committee (IKDC) Subjective Knee Evaluation Form and Tegner–Lysholm Knee Scoring Scale. Between-group comparisons used the independent-samples t-test or Mann–Whitney U test, with significance at p Results : Baseline IKDC scores were comparable (secretome 48.57 ± 4.91 vs. control 47.51 ± 4.45; p > 0.05). At six months, the secretome group showed significantly higher IKDC scores (86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p Conclusion : Adjuvant MSC-derived secretome injection during PLT autograft ACL reconstruction yielded significantly superior six-month functional outcomes. Secretome may serve as a promising cell-free biologic adjuvant to enhance graft healing and early recovery following ACL reconstruction. Level of evidence Level 1 Registry: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT07723625, Registration date: 19 July 2026.
items.summary_zh: 一项双盲随机对照试验在24名接受腘绳肌腱重建的ACL患者中，比较间充质干细胞分泌组局部注射与盐水对六个月功能评分的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随机、双盲设计为无细胞再生干预提供了早期临床信号，但样本量很小，疗效和安全性需要更大规模随访研究确认。
items.author_line: Aryana IGNW, Febyan F, Dusak IWS 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 引言：前交叉韧带（ACL）重建后的移植物愈合仍具挑战性，因为韧带化不充分及腱–骨整合不良可导致移植物失败。间充质干细胞（MSC）来源分泌组是一种含有生物活性因子的无细胞条件培养基，在临床前研究中已显示出有前景的再生潜力。本研究比较了采用腓骨长肌腱（PLT）自体移植物进行ACL重建时，辅以或不辅以分泌组注射的六个月功能结局。方法：一项双盲随机对照试验纳入24名接受关节镜下单束ACL重建并使用PLT自体移植物的受试者，随机分配为向移植物病灶内注射分泌组（分泌组组，n = 12）或生理盐水安慰剂（对照组，n = 12）。功能结局于术前及六个月时采用国际膝关节文献委员会（IKDC）主观膝关节评价表和Tegner–Lysholm膝关节评分量表进行评估。组间比较采用独立样本t检验或Mann–Whitney U检验，显著性水平为p 结果：基线IKDC评分相当（分泌组 48.57 ± 4.91 vs. 对照组 47.51 ± 4.45；p > 0.05）。六个月时，分泌组组的IKDC评分显著更高（86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91；p 结论：在PLT自体移植物ACL重建中辅以MSC来源分泌组注射，可获得显著更优的六个月功能结局。分泌组或可作为有前景的无细胞生物制剂佐剂，以促进ACL重建后的移植物愈合和早期恢复。证据等级：1级 注册：ClinicalTrials.gov，NCT07723625，注册日期：2026年7月19日。
